gtnhextranerf.research.metal_transmutati.english: By combining metal nuggets with aspects, you can create tiny piles of the corresponding metal dust.
gtnhextranerf.research.metal_transmutati.chinese: 将金属粒与要素结合，可以制成相应金属的小撮粉末。

gtnhextranerf.consent.scope.english: Choose one mode or disable reporting. The choice applies to this world and can be changed with /extranerftelemetry and /extranerfteam.
gtnhextranerf.consent.scope.chinese: 选择一种上报方式，或关闭上报。此选择适用于当前世界，可通过 /extranerftelemetry 和 /extranerfteam 随时更改。

gtnhextranerf.consent.minimal.english: Basic statistics contribute to anonymous, aggregated stats on our website. Reports include a random server-run ID, player count, progression tier, world type and optional build proof, but no player names or UUIDs.
gtnhextranerf.consent.minimal.chinese: 基础统计会用于网站上的匿名汇总数据。上报内容包括本次服务器运行的随机标识、玩家人数、进度等级、世界类型，以及可选的构建验证信息；不包含玩家名称或 UUID。

gtnhextranerf.consent.team.english: Team tracking can show your team publicly. Reports include a team ID, leader and online players' names and UUIDs, progression tier, world type and optional build proof.
gtnhextranerf.consent.team.chinese: 队伍追踪可能在网站上公开展示你的队伍。上报内容包括队伍标识、队长及在线玩家的名称和 UUID、进度等级、世界类型，以及可选的构建验证信息。
